Search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) was unavailable during this check (connection refused), and rating-agency pages (CRISIL, India Ratings, CARE) are JavaScript-gated and returned no readable content, so negative-news and rating verification could not be completed. Litigation profile is dominated by ordinary commercial/arbitration and tax-appeal matters typical of a large EPC contractor, with Tata Projects appearing both as claimant and as respondent; no criminal matter involving the company was found in the sources read. Note: the domain www.tataprojects.com returned only an SEO-style title ('Top Ten Construction Company Group in India...') and is not usable as a corporate source.
note: Sanctions: no hit found, but this is NOT a clean confirmation — the OFAC Sanctions List Search tool is JavaScript-driven and returned no queryable results, and web_search was down, so OFAC SDN, UN, EU, UK and BIS Entity List screening could not be executed. sanctions_hit is therefore null (not public/not verifiable in this session), not 'clear'. Court cases: Indian Kanoon shows 15,368 documents mentioning 'Tata Projects Limited' and 13 hits for arbitral-award matters in 2025-2026; the ten most relevant are listed with court, date, party role and status. Rating: null — no rating action could be read from CRISIL/India Ratings/CARE pages (JS-gated, 404s); do not treat as unrated. RF/CIS supply: null — an Indian Kanoon search for 'Tata Projects' + Russia returned 0 matching results, which is absence of court-record evidence only, not proof of no trade; no customs or B-L data was checked (out of scope for this role). Per project rules, sanctions/court matters are not rejection grounds; company retained. Recommend re-running sanctions screening and rating lookup when search access is restored.
